messages:
sam_support: Heads-up — routing a high-priority transfer to CS for AceroHealth (acct: AC-7782). Trial activation is stuck, provisioning API returning 403 for key minting. Trial ends in 4 days, customer mentions legal review pending so churn risk is real. Attaching log snippet and steps we've tried.

deploy-bot: provisioning-job failed — job_id=pf_84a2c; status=403; reason=key_scope_mismatch; eta-retry=30s

maya_csm: Thanks @sam_support — I can take point. Can you paste the full API response + the exact request body you used? Also what's their MRR/ARR so we can prioritize outreach?

sam_support: Request body (redacted): `POST /v1/accounts/AC-7782/keys {"scope":"private:embed","policy":"trial"}` Response payload: `{"error":"forbidden","code":403,"detail":"Key policy incompatible with tenant settings"}` Tried rotating client secret, repro'd from staging and us-west prod. ARR ~ $72k (trial -> paid signal likely).

oliver_csm: Noted — renewal risk high. Immediate plan: 1) short pre-call to unblock activation (assign to enablement), 2) temporary scoped key workaround if ops approves, 3) formal comms to customer with ETA and escalation promise. Who can do the short call in next 2 hours?

maya_csm: I can join a 15-min unblock call at 11:30 PT. Action items I propose: - internal triage w/infra (sam) - manual key issuance as temporary if allowed - schedule technical onboarding deep-dive once provisioned - follow-up email template to customer (see below)

ada_success_manager: I can own the enablement slot for the deep-dive. Also looping legal only if we need to change policy; hold off for now. Share the communications draft and I'll review tone.

sam_support: Infra checked policy flags — tenant has `restrict_trial_keys=true` set from initial signup. That flag blocks `policy:trial` keys. We can either flip that flag (risky) or create a short-lived `support-temp` key with narrower scopes (ops approval required). Workaround command we used locally: ```
# generate temp key for acct AC-7782
POST /internal/ops/keys
{
  "account":"AC-7782",
  "scopes":["embed:read"],
  "ttl_seconds":86400,
  "note":"temp-support-activation"
}
```

maya_csm: Draft customer message (short): 
Hi <Name>,
We spotted a provisioning policy blocking your trial activation. We're arranging an immediate call to get you live within 24 hours. Temporary activation steps are available so you can continue testing while we review policy — we'll share an ETA by EOD. Apologies for the friction.

Can you all review & suggest edits?

oliver_csm: Language looks good. Add: "If you prefer we can delay any policy changes — we'll coordinate and confirm all changes with you." Also set expectations around data/config safety.

ada_success_manager: Approved. I'll draft the calendar invite and include an enablement agenda: 1) confirm use-cases 2) complete provisioning 3) quick-run through key usage and infra considerations 4) next steps for production rollout.

sam_support: Ops is standing by for approval to issue the `support-temp` key. I flagged infra-oncall @infra-team in the ticket: https://redwood.internal/t/ops/6134. If approved, we'll issue temp key and post here.

maya_csm: Scheduling note — I sent calendar invite to AceroHealth for 11:30 PT (15m). Invite includes join link and brief agenda. Ping me if you need me to push to a different time.

sam_support: INFRA ACK — temp key approved for 24h narrow-scope. Issued key id tk_temp_9921. Customer notified (via team email) that activation should now work.

maya_csm: Joined call — walked through the activation flow, they confirmed provisioning success after we swapped in the temp key. Customer requested follow-up onboarding session next Tuesday.

oliver_csm: Great outcome. Next steps (owners): - maya_csm: send the approved draft email and confirm next-week enablement invite - ada_success_manager: run the deep-dive enablement session - sam_support: follow up to revert any temporary flags and create change request if we want to allow trial scope for tenant long-term.

maya_csm: Sent email (cc'd legal and ops per policy): "We're live — temporary key applied; scheduling full enablement next Tue. We'll update on any policy changes ahead of time."

sam_support: Follow-up note — created an ops change request PR #6140 to add a tenant-level override with audit logging. Link: https://redwood.internal/pr/6140

oliver_csm: Closing loop on this thread — excellent cross-team response. If anything regresses please reopen; otherwise I'll mark account as at-risk->engaged in our tracker. :thumbsup:

maya_csm: Marking resolved for now, will update renewal signal after enablement session.

ada_success_manager: I'll capture customer feedback during the enablement and surface any friction to product.

sam_support: Thanks team. Leaving the incident ticket open until PR merged and tenant flags reconciled.
